status: Entirely synthetic connected example. This authored local catalogue is a demonstration harness, not a CSAPI discovery response or an operational installation.
description: Canonical reserved example resource URLs map explicitly to unchanged local response-body files. The loader fetches only these sibling files; it never requests demo.example or guesses linked routes.
limits: The seven original JSON bodies are copied byte-for-byte. Their unrelated fields and unbundled references remain visible; their presence does not authorize traversal.
The schema datastreamRef is explicit catalogue metadata connecting two selected example records; it is not added to either native response body.
Power-a and power-b are identified external sources, not established batteries. No topology, interface, meter, charge percentage, runtime, readiness or pre-replacement reading is invented.
Only one supplied voltage observation exists: power-b at 2026-09-02T10:10:00Z. Earlier view times must not display it as an earlier reading.
Original package manifest view time 2026-09-02T10:20:00Z is not used as an additional sample.
Source-record identity and observation/event/applicability times are distinct from local response URLs and retrieval times.
These source-artifact fragments and bounded client behavior do not establish complete base-schema validity, server discovery, native vendor integration or whole-profile/RFC conformance.
